prompt.project_info: 3:4 handheld iPhone-style documentary figure-skating action portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Two clearly adult original figure skaters, one man and one woman, performing a synchronized dynamic movement on an indoor competition-style ice rink. The man wears a fitted competition skating costume and focused expression; the woman wears a refined elegant skating outfit with confident joyful expression and performance-styled hair.
prompt.composition_elements: Mid-motion candid framing on marked ice with skate lines, reflections and imperfections; blurred spectators and arena seating behind, visible breath vapor, slight motion blur on limbs and authentic cold-air details.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Uneven practical indoor arena lighting, soft stadium glow and cool cold-air atmosphere; spontaneous documentary sports mood without cinematic spotlight.
prompt.technical_specs: 3:4 handheld smartphone 1x lens around 26mm, slight shake, film grain, mild digital noise, compressed highlights, soft shadows, natural white balance and shallow phone portrait depth of field.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Authentic 3:4 handheld iPhone-style documentary image of two clearly adult original figure skaters performing a synchronized dynamic movement on an indoor competition-style ice rink, fitted skating costumes, focused and joyful expressions, blurred spectators, arena lights, skate marks, reflections, breath vapor, slight limb motion blur, natural cold redness, film grain, mild noise and realistic unretouched texture.
